mapper.select: SELECT s.spec_no, s.spec_nm, d.detail_value FROM products_spec s JOIN products_spec_detail d ON s.spec_no = d.spec_no WHERE s.product_category_no = ( SELECT product_category_no FROM model WHERE model_no = #{modelNo} ) AND s.use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY s.spec_no, d.detail_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( products_no, manager_id, model_no, item_no, product_category_no, products_nm, products_status, products_image, register_date, revision_date ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{managerId}, #{modelNo}, #{itemNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{productName}, #{productStatus}, #{productImage}, #{registerDate}, #{revisionDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT item_no AS itemNo, item_nm AS itemNm FROM model WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo}
SELECT DISTINCT brand_no AS brandNo, brand_nm AS brandNm FROM model WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND item_no = #{itemNo}
SELECT model_no, manager_id, brand_no, item_no, product_category_no, model_nm, register_date, revision_date FROM model WHERE model_no = #{modelNo}
SELECT product_category_no AS categoryNo, large_category AS lgCategory, middle_category AS mdCategory, small_category AS smCategory FROM products_category WHERE use_status = '사용중'

SELECT item_no AS itemNo, manager_id AS managerId, product_category_no AS categoryNo, item_nm AS itemName, register_date AS itemRegDate, revision_date AS itemRevDate, use_status AS useStatus FROM item WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND use_status = '사용중'

SELECT b.brand_no AS brandNo, b.manager_id AS managerId, b.brand_nm AS brandName, b.register_date AS brandRegDate, b.revision_date AS brandRevDate FROM brand b JOIN model m ON b.brand_no = m.brand_no WHERE m.item_no = #{itemNo} AND m.product_category_no = #{categoryNo} GROUP BY b.brand_no
SELECT model_no AS modelNo, model_nm AS modelNm FROM model WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND item_no = #{itemNo} AND brand_no = #{brandNo}
